pr_title: disk: sdhc: Switch to clock frequency from DTS
pr_body:
The "spi-max-frequency" property already exists, but was unused. This
now sets the SPI clock frequency to this value (limited to 24MHz) once
initialisation is complete.

Due to the nature of the SPI API, it is necessary to have two separate
configuration structures to switch clock speed as some SPI drivers only
compare pointers to detect changes.

Fixes: #32996, Fixes: #28092, #22906

Improves issue reported in #26513, but does not implement CMD6 to
switch to High Speed mode.

Signed-off-by: Rich Barlow <rich@bennellick.com>
pr_comments: This supersedes #26319. It rebases the change to master and incorporates the requested architectural changes.

issue_context.title: Make SPI speed of SDHC card configurable
issue_context.body: The SD-card-spi driver has a hardcoded 400kHz and 4Mhz SPI bus speed, it would be good to make this configurable (maybe via DT?)
comments: This PR #26319 contains already a working fix, but is still blocked due to some conflicts.
